COMMUNITY MATTERS
6A.
Community Services - A Nice Family Christmas
7.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS #1 (Limited up to a 15-minute period) This portion of the meeting is reserved for comment on items under the Consent Calendar or items that are not on the agenda. Under the Ralph M. Brown Act, City Council cannot act on items raised during public comment but may respond briefly to statements made or questions posed; request clarification; or refer the item to staff. Speakers under Orals are limited to either Oral Communications #1 or Oral Communications #2 and no longer than 1 minute per speaker. If presenting handout material to Council, please provide 11 copies to the City Clerk before speaking.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion and one vote. There will be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed by a Councilmember from the Consent Calendar and considered separately..
8A.
City Clerk – Approve City Council Minutes. Expenditure: None.
Recommendation of the City Clerk that City Council approve the City Council minutes of October 21, 2025.
Staff Report
8B.
General Services – Approve First Amendment to Contract Services Agreement for the Demolition of Building 8 at Charles H. Wilson Park. Expenditure: $50,000 (General Fund).
Recommendation of the General Services Director that City Council approve a first amendment to the contract services agreement (C2025-187), with American Integrated Resources, for the Demolition of Building 8 at Charles H. Wilson Park, for a new contingency of $50,000, and extend the contract term to December 31, 2026.
Staff Report
8C.
General Services – Award Contract Services Agreement for the Creation of an Emergency Operations Center (EOC) – Fire Station 1 and Adopt California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Categorical Exemption Pursuant to Section 15301. Expenditure: $373,783 (Non-General Fund).
Recommendation of the General Services Director that City Council:
1.
Award a contract services agreement to Williamson Construction Co., Inc. of Lawndale, California for the creation of an Emergency Operations Center (EOC) – Fire Station 1 (B2025-22), in the amount of $311,486 and authorize a 20% project contingency of $62,297, for a not-to-exceed total amount of $373,783, for a one-year period beginning November 18, 2025 and ending November 17, 2026; and
2.
Adopt a California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Categorical exemption pursuant to Section 15301 (Existing Facilities); and
3.
Reject lowest apparent bid submitted by First Trade LLC dba YMC as non-responsive; and
4.
Reject second lowest apparent bid submitted by Perfection Painting Co. as non-responsive.
Staff Report
8D.
City Manager and City Treasurer – Adopt RESOLUTION Modifying the Wages, Hours, and Working Conditions for City Treasurer. Expenditure: $38,211 Savings Annually (General Fund).
Recommendation of the City Manager and City Treasurer that City Council:
1.
Adopt a RESOLUTION amending Resolution No. 2018-110 modifying the wages, hours, and working conditions for the City Treasurer; and
2.
Approve modifying the City Treasurer monthly pay point to the amount of $2,860, effective on the new term date of July 14, 2026.
Staff Report
8E.
Police – Adopt RESOLUTION Authorizing Execution of the Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control Local Law Enforcement Grant Contract and Appropriate Grant Award. Expenditure: None.
Recommendation of the Chief of Police that City Council:
1.
Adopt a RESOLUTION authorizing City Manager execution of the California Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control Local Law Enforcement grant contract; and
2.
Appropriate the $18,000 grant award to a newly created grant project.
Staff Report
8F.
Parks and Recreation Commission and Community Services – Approve Pickleball Court Policies at Wilson Park. Expenditure: None.
Recommendation of the Parks and Recreation Commission and Community Services Director that City Council approve pickleball court policies for the new Wilson Park courts.
Staff Report
8G.
Cultural Arts Commission and Community Services – Accept and File Fiscal Year (FY) 2024-25 Cultural Arts Commission Annual Report. Expenditure: None.
Recommendation of the Cultural Arts Commission and Community Services Director that City Council accept and file the Fiscal Year (FY) 2024-25 Cultural Arts Commission Annual Report.
Staff Report
8H.
Community Services – Accept and File Torrance Sister City Association (TSCA) Annual Report and Financial Statement and Approve Grant Request. Expenditure: $5,000 (General Fund).
Recommendation of the Community Services Director that City Council:
1.
Accept and file the Torrance Sister City Association (TSCA) Annual Report and Financial Statement; and
2.
Approve TSCA Grant Request for $5,000.
Staff Report
8I.
Public Works – Award a Consulting Services Agreement for the Design of Torrance Fiber Network and Traffic Signal Optimization, T-195. Expenditure: $863,652 (Non-General Fund).
Recommendation of the Public Works Director that City Council award a consulting services agreement to Architectural Engineering Technology, Inc., dba AET & Associates of Yorba Linda, CA (RFP B2025-19), in the amount of $863,652, for engineering design services for Torrance Fiber Network and Traffic Signal Optimization, T-195, for a two-year period beginning November 19, 2025 and ending November 18, 2027.
Staff Report
8J.
Public Works – Adopt Categorical Exemption Under California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Sections 15269(b), Approve Plans and Specifications, and Award Public Works Agreement for Miscellaneous Water Main Replacements, I-153 (Vista Largo Emergency Water Main Repairs) (B2025-06). Expenditure: $452,256 (Non-General Funds).
Recommendation of the Public Works Director that City Council:
1.
Adopt a finding that the project is categorically exempt under the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to State CEQA Guidelines Section 15269(b); and
2.
Approve the plans and specifications for Miscellaneous Water Main Replacements, I-153 (Vista Largo Emergency Water Main Repairs) (B2025-06); and
3.
Reject the bid submitted by Estate Design and Construction as non-responsive; and
4.
Award a public works agreement to American Pipeline Services of Monrovia, CA, in the amount of $376,880 and authorize a 20% contingency in the amount of $75,376, for construction of Miscellaneous Water Main Replacements, I-153 (Vista Largo Emergency Water Main Repairs) (B2025-06) for a two-year period beginning November 18, 2025, and ending November 17, 2027.
Staff Report
8K.
Library Commission and Community Services – Accept and File the 2024-2025 Library Commission Annual Report. Expenditure: None.
Recommendation of the Library Commission and Community Services Director that City Council accept and file the 2024-2025 Library Commission Annual Report.
Staff Report
8L.
City Manager – Adopt RESOLUTION Modifying the Wages, Hours, and Working Conditions for the City Manager and Repeal Resolution No. 2025-09. Expenditure: $35,609.80 Annually (General Fund).
Recommendation of the City Manager that City Council:
1.
Adopt a RESOLUTION setting forth the wages, hours, and working conditions for the City Manager; and
2.
Approve modifying the City Manager monthly pay point to the amount of $30,988.94, which increases the salary by 9%; and
3.
Repeal Resolution No. 2025-09 in its entirety.
Staff Report
8M.
City Manager – Adopt RESOLUTION Amending Resolution No. 2024-69 for Certain Full-Time Salaried and Hourly Employees to Add the Position of Media Production Supervisor. Expenditure: None.
Recommendation of the City Manager that City Council adopt a RESOLUTION amending Resolution No. 2024-69 for Certain Full-Time Salaried and Hourly Employees to add the Position of Media Production Supervisor.
Staff Report
8N.
City Manager – Approve Side Letter Agreements Between Torrance Municipal Employees-AFSCME Local 1117 (TME-AFSCME) and Management and Torrance City Employees Association (TCEA) and Management. Expenditure: None.
Recommendation of the City Manager that City Council:
1.
Approve a side letter agreement between the Torrance Municipal Employees-AFSCME Local 1117 (TME-AFSCME) and Management to implement General Services Fleet Mechanics and Storekeepers 4-10 Schedule; and
2.
Approve a side letter agreement between Torrance City Employees Association (TCEA) and Management modifying the Extended Steps language for Human Resources Technicians.
Staff Report
9.
HEARINGS – None Scheduled.
10.
ADMINISTRATIVE MATTERS
10A.
City Council State Legislative Advocacy Committee – Accept and File Meeting Minutes and State Legislative Advocacy Update. Expenditure: None.
Recommendation of the City Council State Legislative Advocacy Committee that City Council:
1.
Accept and file the October 22, 2025, City Council State Legislative Advocacy Committee meeting minutes; and
2.
Accept and file the State Legislative Advocacy update.
Staff Report
11.
AGENCY AGENDAS – None Scheduled.
12.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS #2 (Limited up to a 15-minute period) This portion of the meeting is reserved for comments on items that are not on the agenda. Under the Ralph M. Brown Act, City Council cannot act on items raised during public comment but may respond briefly to statements made or questions posed; request clarification; or refer the item to staff. Speakers under Orals are limited to either Oral Communications #1 or Oral Communications #2 and no longer than 1 minute per speaker. Time starts when you step up to the microphone. If presenting handout material to Council, please provide 11 copies to the City Clerk before speaking. Handouts will be distributed while you speak.
RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION
RECONVENE TO OPEN SESSION
14.
ADJOURNMENT Adjournment of City Council meeting to Tuesday, December 2, 2025, at 5:00 p.m. for closed session with regular business commencing at 6:30 p.m. in the LeRoy J. Jackson Council Chamber.
Tuesday, November 25, 2025 is a City Council Dark Night.
